page_title: ItsPaint — MS Paint for Mac, free and open source

sources.entry: ItsPaint - Native paint and screenshot markup: step badges, pixelate, Instant Alpha. No account or telemetry. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/joshlin2201/itspaint) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: ItsPaint
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source, native macOS paint and screenshot markup app that works like MS Paint, with blank canvases, image compositing, and annotation tools.
use_cases: Annotate screenshots with numbered steps for bug reports
Create a blank canvas at a set pixel size
Paste one image onto another and reposition it
Pixelate or hide sensitive information in a screenshot
Remove an image background without uploading
Crop and zoom to inspect an image
summary.what_it_does: Provides a blank canvas at any pixel size and lets you drop or paste an image onto another, where it floats until moved or scaled by its corner handles. It can take a screenshot directly into the editor (region, window, or a global hotkey) and offers markup tools such as numbered step badges, pixelate, spotlight dimming, clone-style pixel copying, arrows, callouts, and shapes. Background removal runs locally via a single command, with Instant Alpha as a manual tolerance-based option. It opens and exports PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, HEIC, AVIF, PDF and ICO, and stores native documents as lossless PNG with a JSON sidecar.
notable: MIT licensed, open source, zero third-party dependencies, and no network code according to the page
Numbered step badges and pixelate tool for screenshot walkthroughs
Background removal runs entirely on-device with no model or upload
Installable via Homebrew cask, Mac App Store, or notarised disk image
caveats: Mac-only; the page names no other platforms
